## Summary

Completes ADR 0122 spatial audio first-release requirements and closes remaining lifecycle/test coverage. The visual-validation fixture does not fabricate an unresolved audio asset and focuses the constrained capture on the Audio Emitter/Listener Inspector while retaining Scene View spatial gizmos.

## Validation

Fresh Windows affected validation and task-specific Spatial Audio Editor Visual Validation are required on the final head.
